search_window.basis: From the independently verified previous Food Line supplementary watch completion through this observation; search terms also covered prior-day articles to account for indexing delays.

coverage_notes: Supplementary recall watch only. Authoritative national production collection and editorial gates remain unchanged.

Executed exactly 12 targeted web searches for the four audit miss classes: sole/last/full-service grocery losses; storm/fire/outage-related emergency distribution cancellations; abrupt pantry or food-bank service losses; and current official SNAP/WIC/EBT interruptions.
No new, sufficiently verified qualifying U.S. food-access disruption in the hourly observation window was identified.
The October 27 Wymore, Nebraska sole-grocery closure reporting was already handed off earlier; excluded as duplicate.

October 27 search results about a Colorado Clark's Market closure in Battlement Mesa/Parachute were only from an unattributed secondary excerpt and did not establish a new closure date or trustworthy original provenance. Excluded pending stronger primary/local sourcing, not asserted as a newly verified event.

Montgomery County, Maryland's October 26–30 So What Else food-distribution cancellations were scheduled for Food Rescue Week; they were not attributed to a storm, flood, fire, outage, or facility damage and are excluded under this watch's criteria.
The Kenosha Food Bank end-of-2026 closure announcement was published October 21, 2026 and does not constitute a newly abrupt closure in this interval.

Search results mentioning October 2025 federal-shutdown SNAP interruptions and September 2026 El Paso storm damage were historical and excluded. No new official 2026 SNAP or WIC interruption was substantiated.
The already recorded South Philadelphia pantry fire and earlier Utah reductions remain excluded as duplicate handoffs.
Search-engine indexing delays mean a no-findings result is not proof of nationwide absence. All 12 search operations returned usable results; no material search degradation detected.
No editorial approval, publication, social posting, primary collection changes, schedule changes, or task disabling occurred.
